timeline.quote: He cut her from her bindings

timeline.summary: Khrad and Amarth-Tel fight on the roof; Nathala starts the vehicle with the stolen key and kills Amarth-Tel.
timeline.quote: Amarth-Tel was killed beneath the vehicle's wheels.

timeline.summary: Khrad apologizes to Nathala for disregarding her skill and accompanies her study of the vehicle, not returning to Mon'Telu for years.
timeline.quote: Khrad did not return to Mon'Telu for many years.
